dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: The type that the Fatui love to cram full of weapons. To twist technology meant to serve humanity into tools for evil... What a waste of genius. What an utterly fatuous farce, perfectly befitting their organization's name.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: These mechanisms here can't be modified that way — or rather, the cost of doing so would exceed that of building a new one from scratch. They're strictly limited to domestic purposes, so think carefully before buying one.
